# The ESPHome release this repository builds with, in the one form Dependabot reads (pip, this
# directory). The same number is written in .github/workflows/qa.yaml and esphome-release.yaml
# (ESPHOME_VERSION), firmware/scripts/dev.py and firmware/scripts/esphome-upstream-check.sh.
# firmware/scripts/version-lint.py holds those four equal, and the lint-extra job of the QA
# workflow holds this file equal to them. So a pull request that bumps this line fails until the
# other four are bumped with it, which is the reminder. The nightly workflow installs from here.
esphome==2026.10.0
